description: Browser collection requests the Google tag sends to the GA4 /g/collect transport.

params.name: v
params.description: GA4 collection uses protocol version 2. Version 1 is Universal Analytics, which stopped processing data.
params.fix_hint: Send `v=2` from a Google tag configured for a GA4 property.

params.name: tid
params.description: It is the GA4 measurement ID, which starts with `G-`. A `UA-` value here is a Universal Analytics property that no longer collects data.
params.fix_hint: Point the tag at a GA4 measurement ID.

params.name: cid
params.description: It is the client ID that ties events to one browser. Without it, hits cannot be attributed to a session.
